purpose: Prevent conversational memory, stale summaries, source literals or generated text from overriding current primary evidence and repository-controlled facts.

canonical_identity_lock.historical_literal_rule: A forbidden form may appear only inside a clearly labelled faithful quotation, transcription-error record, correction notice or retrieval-only search variant. It must never be normalized into a canonical identity.
canonical_identity_lock.separation_rule: OSWELL 426 S.L. is a distinct Spanish entity and must never be merged with UK company 07716847.

source_authority_order: official registries and current public authorities
ChatGPT memory summaries and generated analysis

store: official correspondence uses the SBU business account
memory_policy.rule: Memory selects retrieval and applies durable constraints; it never substitutes for live verification or primary evidence.

source_roles.github: Active continuity and publication surface while GitLab repository access is blocked; live refs, checks and deployment state must be retrieved dynamically.
source_roles.gitlab: Intended canonical lineage and public website; public site may be read live, but inaccessible repository state must not be guessed.
source_roles.email: Original thread governs recipients and wording. Official correspondence uses sbu001@monterecco.com. Read back every sent message.
source_roles.files: Current controlled file version governs; do not treat an old extraction or summary as the native source.
source_roles.web: Use current authoritative primary sources for time-sensitive or registry facts.
source_roles.chatgpt_memory: Durable contextual aid only; correct, suppress or disregard stale summaries when they conflict with primary evidence or current repository controls.

outbound_preflight: Resolve every legal entity through ops/CANONICAL_ENTITY_NAMES.json.
Reject forbidden identity variants outside labelled historical quotations or correction notices.
Verify person names, case references, dates and identifiers.
Resolve recipients from the actual thread and preserve the narrow intended To/CC set.
Verify every public link before transmission.
Read back the exact Sent copy or deployed bytes.
Record the Gmail message ID, commit SHA or live URL as applicable.

correction_event.issue: Four external messages sent on 2026-09-21 inherited an erroneous Oswell/Oswell Limited template form.
correction_event.resolution: Thread-preserving corrections were sent to the Consejo Canario/inter-Colegio, PwC, RSM and Grant Thornton recipient sets, identifying AWESWELL LIMITED (company number 07716847) as the correct legal name.
correction_event.recurrence_rule: Do not silently rewrite preserved historical messages. Prevent recurrence at generation and preflight stages.

account_memory_manual_boundary: ChatGPT cannot directly edit the user's account-level Memory summary or settings. The user-controlled Memory UI must remove or correct any statement treating Oswell as canonical or as an alias of AWESWELL LIMITED.
